messages:
Sana: Quick heads-up — we're prepping a q4b-int4 candidate for a long-context canary. Local smoke showed a small quality regression on code-summary prompts and some captioned images. I think the issue is dedupe + provenance mismatch after tokenization tweaks. Need a short curation sprint to refresh the gold set before we canary.

Olivia: Can you summarize the concrete ask for curation?

Sana: Sure. Observed problem: quant kernel change altered how inline code and decorative OCR text normalize, which shifted our fingerprint hashes. The hash pipeline (text-hash + image p-hash) missed ~3% duplicates and exposed ~40 items where gold labels disagree with new outputs. Proposed flow: (1) fuzzy dedupe on image+caption pairs, (2) perceptual clustering (p-hash + sim threshold), (3) surface ~500 high-risk clusters for relabel, (4) lock golden and run eval sweep.

Jay: Where are the candidate rows stored and how big is the set?

Sana: s3://redwood-curation/anchorbank/q4b_candidates/2026-03-20/candidates.parquet — ~120k rows. We'll stratify by model-error-rate and cluster size when sampling.

Ben: I can run the fuzzy pass. Command (last run):
```
python tools/fuzzy_dedupe.py --input s3://redwood-curation/anchorbank/q4b_candidates/2026-03-20/candidates.parquet --out s3://redwood-curation/anchorbank/q4b_candidates/dedupe_clusters.json --threshold 0.82
```
I'll kick it off tomorrow morning and upload cluster metadata + top clusters.

Maya: I'll pull labelers for the relabel batch. Proposed QA: 3 annotators per item, majority consensus, and short instruction checklist for multimodal edgecases (decorative text, watermarks, OCR). ETA for relabel job?

Maya: Also, please include binary thumbs-up/thumbs-down examples in the instructions — last time we had inconsistent marking on decorative overlays.

Sana: Good idea. Drafted a short instruction doc in Notion: https://notion.so/rw/anchorbank-multimodal-handbook — will add examples and edgecase screenshots. Use queue id `ml_anchor_relabel_v2`.

LabellerBot: Created labeling job `ml_anchor_relabel_v2` with 520 items — due 2026-03-24 18:00 UTC. Assigned owners: Maya, Liam, Arman.

Liam: I'll claim ~200 items and prioritize clusters flagged as high-conflict. Target complete by 2026-03-23.

Arman: I'll do a QC pass on a 50-item gold spotcheck after the relabel to validate inter-annotator consistency.

Sana: After relabel, run eval sweep: sample 2k prompts across hosted/dedicated/q4b-candidate; compute anchor recall and hallucination delta. Promotion criteria: hallucination delta < 1.5% absolute and recall within baseline ±1%. If we meet criteria we push to canary.

Olivia: Can someone link the quantization smoke-test runbook and the rollback steps if metrics regress post-relabel?

Sana: I'll embed the smoke checklist into the Notion doc and ping infra for a canary window. Also adding S3 paths and seed lists for reproducibility.

deploy-bot: Canary slot reserved on `dedicated-gpu-12` for 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC.

Sana: Owners / next steps:
- Ben: Run fuzzy dedupe and upload cluster file + metadata (by 2026-03-21)
- Maya: Finalize labeling instructions and confirm `ml_anchor_relabel_v2` job (by 2026-03-21)
- Liam & Arman: Finish labeling and QC (by 2026-03-24)
- Sana: Run eval sweep and decide on canary promotion (2026-03-25)

Olivia: :eyes:

Ben: Starting the fuzzy dedupe now, will post cluster summary + top 500 clusters when done.

Sana: Thanks all — I'll update the Notion doc and drop a short summary in #eng-ml once clusters and the relabel job are live. :thumbsup:

Jay: One extra ask — can we tag any clusters that contain code snippets vs natural language captions? That helps isolate the code-summary regression signal.

Ben: Yep adding a `has_code_snippet` flag in the cluster metadata output.

Maya: Also adding a short checklist for labelers: (a) ignore decorative stamps, (b) prefer majority intent across image+caption, (c) mark OCR-noise as uncertain.

Arman: Noted. I'll include the QC rubric in the spotcheck job.

Sana: If relabel shows the delta reduction we proceed. If not, rollback plan is documented in the smoke runbook with model pin to previous quant profile.

Olivia: Appreciate the quick turnaround on this — small curation sprints are lifesavers for onboarding new quant variants.

LabellerBot: Label job `ml_anchor_relabel_v2` status: queued.

Ben: Cluster run complete — uploading s3://redwood-curation/anchorbank/q4b_candidates/dedupe_clusters_1718233333.json (summary: 124k input -> 14.8k clusters, 512 clusters flagged high-risk). Posting short CSV of top clusters now.

Sana: Great, I'll kickoff the sample selection and seed the label job with the top 520. Will follow up with final eval results after labeling completes.
